post.title: Thanksgiving Online Sales Hit $7.1B, Beating the Forecast
post.ig:
Americans spent a record $7.1 billion online on Thanksgiving Day.
Adobe had forecast $6.9 billion. The actual was up 10.4% from last year.
A record 63.2% of it was spent on phones.
Next up: Adobe expects $12.9B on Black Friday and $15.1B on Cyber Monday.
Source: Adobe Analytics data, as reported by Anadolu Agency and 24/7 Wall St. (Nov 27, 2026).
